spans.s: See सं-√ कन्.
(cf. √ काश्) P. -चकास्ति, to light up, illuminate, BhP.
greatly startled, trembling, afraid, W.
a priest, sage, L.
&c. See सं- √ 1. चि.
(ifc. f(आ). ) collection, gathering, accumulation, heap, hoard, store, multitude, quantity (dat., ‘in order to have more’), Nir.; MBh. &c.
collecting the bones of a burnt body (in अस्थि-स्˚),
RTL. 284
(scil. क्रतु, a ceremony) at which the Soma is accumulated, Pāṇ. iii, 1, 130.
going about, moving (see दिवा-स्˚)
going or belonging together, simultaneous, VS.; ĀpŚr.
(ifc. f(आ). ) passage, a way, road, path, place for walking (esp. the space assigned to each person who takes part in a rite), TS.; ŚBr.; ŚrS.; Kālid.; Kathās.
a difficult passage, defile, bridge over a torrent &c., W.
(in Sāṃkhya) evolution, development, emanation, Tattvas.
the body, L.
killing, W.
(ifc. f(आ). ) walking about, wandering, roaming, driving or riding, any motion, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
transit, passage, ib.
the passage or entrance of the sun into a new sign, MW.
passing over, transition, transference to (comp.), Yājñ.
transmission (of disease), contagion, W.
course, path, way (also fig. = ‘mode, manner’), MBh.; Hariv.
track (of wild animals), Śak., Sch.
course of life, career, Sāh.
a partic. class of spies, L.
difficult progress, difficulty, distress, W.
leading, guiding, ib.
inciting, impelling, ib.
a gem supposed to be in the head of a serpent, ib.
= हुं-कार, ChUp.
सं-चर॑—भागिन् mfn. obtaining a share with difficulty (?), Vas.
सं-˚च॑रण mf(ई)n. fit or suitable for going or walking upon, accessible, practicable, RV.; ŚBr.
going or coming together, meeting, converging, MW.
सं-˚च॑रण (अम्), n. going together or through, passage, motion, passing over from (abl.) or in (loc. or comp.) or by means of (comp.), Kāv.; Pañcat.
(with समुद्र॑म्) navigation, RV.
setting in motion, use, MW.
सं-˚चारण n. bringing near, conveying, mixing, adding, transmission, insertion, Kāv.; Sāh.
delivering (a message), Jātakam.
सं-˚चरित्र n. coupling, procuring, L.
सं-˚चरिष्णु mfn. disposed to move or ramble about, Śiś.
सं-˚चरे॑ण्य mfn. suitable for going or walking on, practicable, RV.
सं-चार—जीविन् m. (prob.) a tramp, vagabond, L.
सं-चार—पथ m. a walk, walking-place, Hariv.
(in dram.) a female attendant on a king (= यवनी), Bhar.
सं-चार—पूत mfn. purified by the course or passage (of anything), MW.
सं-चार—व्याधि m. a partic. (prob. infectious) disease, L.
सं-˚चारक m. a leader, guide, Hit.
N. of one of Skanda's attendants, MBh.
सं-˚चारिका (इका), f. a procuress, go-between, L.
a female servant to whom is entrusted the principal care (of money matters &c.), L.
the nose, L.
movable, moving, MBh.
सं-˚चारणी (ई), f. (with Buddhists) N. of one of the 6 goddesses of magic,
Dharmas. 13
सं-˚चारणीय mfn. to be walked or wandered through or circumambulated, Bālar.
to be transmitted or transferred to (loc.), Sāh.
सं-˚चारयितृ m. (and ˚त्री f. fr. Caus.) a leader, guide, MaitrUp., Sch.
सं-˚चारयित्री f., a leader, guide
सं-˚चारित mfn. (fr. id.) caused to go, set in motion, impelled, driven, guided, Kālid.; Rājat.
transmitted, communicated (as a disease), W.
सं-˚चारित m. a person who carries out the intentions of his masters, L.
संचारि—ता f. penetration into (comp.), Mcar.
for सं-चारिन् in comp.
संचारि—चुण्डिका f. an easily propagated cutaneous eruption, smallpox, Gal.
संचारि—त्व n. transitoriness, inconstancy (of feeling), Sāh.
संचारि—भाव m. a transitory feeling (= व्यभि-चारि-भ्˚, q.v.), MW.
going together or about, going hither and thither, roaming, wandering, moving in (loc. or comp.), Kāv.; Rājat.; Kathās.; Inscr.
going or passing from one to another, transmitted, infectious, contagious, hereditary (as a disease), Yājñ.; Rājat.
ascending and descending (applied to a note or tone), Saṃgīt.
penetrating into (comp.), Mcar.
coming together, meeting, in contact with, adjacent or contiguous to (instr.), Kād.
taken or carried together with one (as an umbrella &c.), Rājat.
carrying with one (comp.), Kām.
being in (comp.), Suśr.; Mṛcch.
engaged in, occupied with (comp.), Pañcar.
passing away, transitory, adventitious, unsteady, inconstant, fickle (= व्य्-अभिचारिन्, q.v.), Śiś.; Sāh.
influencing, impelling, setting in motion, MaitrUp.
difficult, inaccessible, W.
incense or the smoke rising from burnt incense, L.
air, wind, L.
(इणी), f. a kind of Mimosa (= हंस-पदि), L.
transitoriness, inconstancy (of feeling), Sāh.
to be walked upon, accessible (in अ-स्˚, q.v.)
brought about or produced by (comp.), Śaṃk.
the act of chewing or masticating, Rājat.
moving about, trembling, quivering
(of unknown meaning), BrahmaP.
सं-चल—नाडि f. ‘moving tube’, an artery, vein, pulse, R.
सं-˚चलन n. moving about, agitation, trembling, shaking, Kāv.; Dhātup.
the seed of Abrus Precatorius, L.
सं-˚चालक m. a guide (perhaps w.r. for ˚चारक), L.
See संचिष्क्˚, col. 2.
(said to be fr. √ 2. चि; but cf. सं-चक्षस्) a Ṛṣi, L.
सं-√ 2. चि (only in ind.p. -चित्य, perhaps w.r. for -चिन्त्य), to reflect, ponder, Rājat.
सं-चय—वत् mfn. possessed of wealth, rich, opulent, MBh.
सं-˚चयन n. the act of piling or heaping together, heaping up, gathering, collecting (esp. the ashes or bones of a body lately burnt See अस्थि-स्˚), GṛŚrS.; Mn. &c.
सं-˚चयनीय mfn. to be gathered or collected, MW.
सं-˚चयिक mfn. having provisions (in अ- and मास-संच्˚ qq.vv.)
सं-˚चयिन् mfn. who or what collects, W.
possessed of riches, MBh.
सं-˚च˚यि—त्व n. the being heaped up, Suśr.
piled together, heaped up, gathered, collected, accumulated, ŚBr. &c. &c.
dense, thick (as a wood), R.
fitted or provided with, full of (comp.), MBh.
impeded, obstructed, VarBṛS.
frequently practised or exhibited, MBh.
सं-चित—कर्मन् n. the rites to be performed after arranging the sacrificial fire, ŚrS.
सं-˚चिति f. N. of the 9th book of the Śatapatha-brāhmaṇa
heaping together, collecting, saving, Kāv.

etym.s: fr. -चिन्वान, pr. p. Ā. of सं- √ 1. चि

spans.s: occupied with the accumulation of wealth or treasures, MBh.
to be gathered or collected or accumulated, R. (cf. Pāṇ. iii, 5, 130, Sch.)
wishing to do or perform, Kull. on Mn. v, 86.
wishing to give a short description, VarBṛS.
Salvinia Cucullata, L.

सं-√ चिन्त् P. -चिन्तयति (ind.p. -चिन्त्य, or -चिन्तयित्वा), to think about, think over, consider carefully, reflect about (acc.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.;
to design, intend, destine, BhP.
सं-˚चिन्तन n. careful consideration or reflection, anxiety, Bhpr.
सं-˚चिन्तित mfn. carefully considered or thought about, deliberated, weighed (-वत् mfn. ‘one who has carefully considered’ or ‘he has carefully considered’), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
designed, appointed, BhP.
सं-˚चिन्तित—वत् mfn., ‘one who has carefully considered’ or ‘he has carefully considered’
1. सं-चिन्त्य ind. intentionally, Divyāv.
2. सं-चिन्त्य mfn. to be thought over or considered, Yājñ.; MBh.
to be regarded as (वत् ifc.), R. (cf. दुः-संच्˚).

etym.s: fr. Desid. of Caus. of सं-√ स्कृ

spans.s: wishing any one (acc.) to perform a purificatory rite, MBh. xv, 706 (B. सं-चस्क्˚).
Nom. Ā. ˚यते, to assume the coarse dress or rags of an ascetic, Anarghar. (cf. Pāṇ. iii, 1, 20).
‘impeller’, N. of a Devaputra, Lalit.
सं-˚चोदन m. (or f(आ). ) urging, exciting, inflaming, arousing, MBh.; Jātakam.
सं-˚चोदना f. a stimulant, MBh.
सं-˚चोदयितव्य mfn. (fr. Caus.) to be urged on or impelled, Hariv.
सं-˚चोदित mfn. (fr. id.) impelled, ordered, commanded, BhP.
सं-√ चूर्ण् P. -चूर्णयति, to grind to powder, comminute, pulverize, Suśr.
the act of grinding to powder, comminution, crushing or breaking to pieces, Alaṃkārat.
सं-˚चूर्णित mfn. completely pulverized or comminuted, cut or broken to pieces, MBh.; Śaṃk.; Rājat.
सं-√ चूष् Pass. -चूष्यते, to be in a state of great heat, boil over, Suśr.
सं-√ चृत् P. -चृतति, to be joined with (instr.), AV. iii, 31, 1.
junction, union, RV. ix, 84, 2.

सं-√ चेष्ट् Ā. -चेष्टते, to move about restlessly, be disturbed, MBh.;
to exert one's self, strive, act, ib.
सं-√ च्यु Caus. -च्यावयति, to cause to fall off, strike off, remove, MBh.
